name: Grade 9 IT Practice: April Week 8 - State Prototype
description: Practice words for Grade 9 first-trimester physical computing work.

words.definition: Rules for how a system changes between states.
words.example: The state logic chose between idle, warning, and finished modes.

words.definition: An input that starts a response.
words.example: The button press was the input trigger that started the prototype.

words.definition: What the system does after an input.
words.example: The output response was a blinking light and short buzzer sound.

words.definition: A test version of one physical-computing feature before the full build.
words.example: The prototype tested one feature before the full project build.

words.definition: A record of project work and tests.
words.example: The project log recorded the wiring change and test result.

words.definition: A design or code change that makes the prototype clearer or more reliable.
words.example: The improvement made the warning light easier to see.
